app_tagline: A Multimodal AI-Based Farm Intelligence and Decision Support System

thermal_subtitle: Analyze canopy infrared thermography to identify stomatal closure, evapotranspiration deficit, and localized hotspots.

marketplace_subtitle: List your harvested produce or connect directly with verified wholesale buyers, mills, and food processors.

farm_3d_subtitle: Interactive 3D representation of your 4.5-acre farm parcels with live telemetry, canopy temperatures, and stress overlays.
